entry.title: [sepah] Yaminpour's account of presenting the blessed ring of the Leader of the…
entry.summary:
Machine-translated from the original Telegram post.

Source: @sepah

Yaminpour's account of presenting the blessed ring of the Leader of the Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, to the family of martyr Hossein Hashem: Last night we spent visiting the families of martyrs. Shining diamonds in small houses in the back alleys of Dahieh... This is the house of martyr Hossein Hashem. His three children came in silence and set our hearts ablaze. This martyr is well known among the recent martyrs because in his will video he explained the location and manner of his martyrdom. We have brought with us the chafieh and the blessed ring of the dear Leader of the Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei. Every time we mention the name of Imam Seyyed Mojtaba, they send salawat. The martyr's wife did not say a single word — she put the chafieh over her face and wept. Cyber Corps of the Pasdaran👇🏻☑️ @SEPAH
